handbook.timevortex.home.intro: How to build and fly a TARDIS, from the first console to the police box.
handbook.timevortex.welcome.4: Gather titanium, Time Steel and Blood Crystal Shards, and get a generator burning for artron power.
handbook.timevortex.welcome.5: Make a console, give it a TARDIS Matrix, then fit the modules that make it fly.
handbook.timevortex.chapter.materials.de: What consoles and modules are made from.
handbook.timevortex.metals.1: Titanium is the frame metal. The console, Hull Glue, generators and conduits use it.
handbook.timevortex.metals.2: Time Steel goes into almost every module. Craft it from a uranium ingot and a netherite scrap.
handbook.timevortex.metals.3: Gold carries artron, so cells, links and most of the finer modules need it.
handbook.timevortex.metals.4: The top modules take netherite: the Rig Controller, Hull Stabiliser III, Navigation Calibrator III, the Dimensional Stabiliser and the police box upgrades.
handbook.timevortex.blood_crystals.1: A Blood Crystal Shard holds the charge a TARDIS runs on. The Matrix, Artron Cells, Fluid Links, the Time Rotor and the Dematerialisation Circuit each need one.
handbook.timevortex.blood_crystals.2: Shards don't burn. Feed the Artron Generator coal or charcoal instead.
handbook.timevortex.parts.1: Processing Units go into the console, the Matrix and the first flight modules.
handbook.timevortex.parts.2: Enderic Compound goes into the navigation modules, the Scanner, the rig pylons and the tier II upgrades.
handbook.timevortex.parts.3: An Advanced Computing Engine runs the big jobs: crossing dimensions, the Rig Controller, the tier III upgrades and anything that changes the police box.
handbook.timevortex.matrix.1: The Matrix is the heart of a TARDIS. Fit it to a console to bring it to life.
handbook.timevortex.matrix.2: It's made in an Assembler from a titanium ingot, a Time Steel ingot, a Processing Unit and a Blood Crystal Shard.
handbook.timevortex.matrix.3: Whoever fits the Matrix owns the TARDIS, so fit it yourself.
handbook.timevortex.chapter.machines.des: Artron power and the machines that use it.
handbook.timevortex.capacitor.3: It also trades power with ordinary FE machines: 1 AU is %s FE.
handbook.timevortex.atmosphere.1: Somewhere with no air, it fills a sealed room with air, up to %s blocks.
handbook.timevortex.power_modules.2: Fit at least one Fluid Link, or no artron flows. It's crafted ready to use.
handbook.timevortex.scanner.2: It finds players, other TARDISes, structures and biomes. Pick one to set a course for it.
handbook.timevortex.repairs.3: Time Steel patches the simpler modules and a gold ingot the finer ones. Hull Stabiliser III, Navigation Calibrator III and the Dimensional Stabiliser need a netherite ingot.
handbook.timevortex.this_book.1: Finishing A Rough Start, the first TARDIS task in The Workshop, gets you this book.
handbook.timevortex.this_book.2: Lost it? Craft another from a book and some Hull Glue.
